target_title: From-scratch NumPy plus PyTorch/Hugging Face dual implementation
note: Cross-cutting dual-implementation feature (32 owning tasks, 0a-15b). >6 tasks, so per REVIEWER.md: earliest (0a/0b), latest (15a/15b), plus 14a/14b (flagged, see below) read in full; the remaining 13 lessons corroborated via a full-corpus static scan (numpy import in every theory notebook, torch import in every practical notebook, present for all 32/32) plus their own already-completed independent agent reviews (FEAT-DL5..DL17,DL19), each of which explicitly confirmed from-scratch NumPy + PyTorch/HF dual implementation and numeric/accuracy agreement as part of its own verdict. AC-1 met: 0a hand-derives a 2-layer NumPy net solving XOR with an exact-match assertion (no torch); 14a implements AE/VAE/diffusion forward process from scratch in NumPy with gradient-check and closed-form-vs-Monte-Carlo KL assertions; 15a implements int8 quantise/dequantise from scratch in NumPy against the notebook's own trained weights. AC-2 met: 0b reproduces the same shape in PyTorch (autograd, nn.Module, trained on FashionMNIST); 14b trains a real PyTorch VAE and a minimal MLP diffusion model on MNIST; 15b reproduces mixed-precision/quantisation/distillation via torch.autocast, torch.quantization.quantize_dynamic and a real training loop. AC-3 met: 0a/0b show a qualitative same-shape-now-trained agreement (introductory lesson, no direct numeric comparison by design); 15a/15b show exact numeric agreement (quantisation memory ratio 4x/2x, distillation KL/agreement pattern reproduced); 14a/14b show VAE-vs-diffusion sample-quality and training-curve comparison side by side. Flag, not a defect against these criteria: 14a cell 26/27 claims the diffusion forward schedule reaches alpha_bar_T approx 0 by design and calls this 'confirmed numerically' -- independently recomputed here (alpha_bar[-1]=0.132 at T=200 in 14a, 0.364 at T=100 in 14b) and it is false, a genuine correctness-of-derivation defect. This is already caught, correctly rejected under FEAT-DL18's own AC-3/AC-6 (REVIEW-DL063), and already has fix task TASK-DL046 filed -- not re-filed or re-rejected here to avoid duplicating that tracked fix; it does not bear on FEAT-DL2's own AC-1/2/3 (implementation exists, practical reproduces, VAE-vs-diffusion comparison shown), which are satisfied independent of the schedule-constant error.
